name: AICardMetric
description: AICardMetric renders a KPI summary at basic / simple / rich / robust densities. Simple is a fast-scan tile (label + value + trend). Rich adds business context (target, source, freshness, status, secondary metric, action link). Robust adds AI insight, confidence, view-sources / view-rationale, and primary + secondary actions. Higher-density-only props are ignored with a dev warning at lower densities.
intent: Simple optimizes for scanning. Rich adds business context. Robust adds AI insight, trust metadata, and action — all from one density prop.

authority.note: Imported from godesign27/agentic-ui-design-system (branch cursor/import-ai-components-6d77). Runtime TSX lives under src/components/ai/. Existing top-level shadcn ports remain authoritative for the governed AI kit.

variants.name: rich
variants.hint: adds status, target, source, freshness, secondary, action link

variants.name: robust
variants.hint: adds insight, confidence, sources, rationale, actions

props.name: density
props.hint: Controls which fields render. Higher-density-only fields are ignored (with dev warning) at lower densities.

props.name: label
props.hint: Eyebrow label (uppercase) for simple/rich/robust; sentence-case title at density=basic.

props.name: value
props.hint: Primary KPI value.

props.name: unit
props.hint: Optional unit suffix rendered inline with the value.

props.name: valueSize
props.hint: Type scale for the metric value.

props.name: accent
props.hint: Dot + bottom rail color. Ignored at density=basic.

props.name: icon
props.hint: basic only. ZAIDYN zs-icon-* preferred, or any React node.

props.name: trend
props.hint: tone is positive | negative | neutral. Ignored at density=basic.

props.name: status
props.hint: Rich+. Top-right status pill.

props.name: target
props.hint: Rich+. Comparison line (Target: 81%).

props.name: source
props.hint: Rich+. Source chip; icon defaults to zs-icon-data-table.

props.name: freshness
props.hint: Rich+. Freshness chip with clock glyph.

props.name: secondaryMetric
props.hint: Rich. Sub-row beneath the primary metric.

props.name: actionLink
props.hint: Rich. Bottom-row action link with right-chevron.

props.name: insight
props.hint: Robust. Body for the AI INSIGHT callout.

props.name: confidence
props.hint: Robust. XX% confidence pill — green ≥80 / amber 60–79 / red <60.

props.name: onViewSources
props.hint: Robust. Renders the View sources link.

props.name: onViewRationale
props.hint: Robust. Renders View rationale in the action row.

props.name: primaryAction
props.hint: Robust. Primary AIButton.

props.name: secondaryAction
props.hint: Robust. Secondary AIButton.

props.name: loading
props.hint: Skeleton state — value swaps for a shimmer bar.

props.name: onClick
props.hint: Makes the entire card clickable.

props.name: accentBar
props.hint: Opt-in 2px bottom rail in the accent color.

notes: Use AI tokens from ai-tokens.ts — do not hardcode brand hex.
Accent amber/green use ZS_AMBER[60] / ZS_GREEN[60] per metric-card.accent tokens.
Compose from co-located atoms — do not invent lookalikes.
Self-contained under components/ai/ — do not require @zaidyn/ai-ui.

keyboard: Ensure keyboard focus order matches visual order
Clickable cards expose aria-label from label + value

forbiddenUsage: Do not invent dependency atomics — use bundled canonical sources
Do not hardcode brand hex — use AI tokens
Do not require @zaidyn/ai-ui for agent implementations — use co-located TSX
Do not pass robust-only props at simple/rich density (dev warning)

experienceMetadata.accountability: Confidence · Data quality · Data freshness · Rationale
